title: Streamlined eval-lite fastpath for enterprise model adds and temporary pinning
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: Large enterprise customers sometimes request new model additions or a temporary version pin to meet regulatory or performance needs. Full eval pipelines and gated onboarding can take multiple weeks, which is acceptable for standard catalog flows but blocks high-value customers. We need a controlled fastpath: 'eval-lite' that performs a lightweight, defensible set of checks (latency, key regressions, safety smoke tests), plus a temporary pinning mechanism that allows customers to run against a pinned variant for a limited window while we complete full onboarding.
background_and_goals: Provide a time-boxed fast onboarding lane for strategic enterprise requests that need <72h exposure to a new model variant
Ensure customer apps can rely on predictable behavior via temporary pinning with auto-unpin or expiry
Keep product and engineering risk low with shadow-staging and telemetry thresholds that gate extension to full catalog onboarding
Create operational runbook for rollback, audit trails, and post-mortem triggers
acceptance_criteria: Eval-lite harness implemented: runs a concise suite (latency p50/p95, token-cost estimate, primary eval set accuracy, basic hallucination checks, common safety heuristics) against candidate model in <2 hours
Temporary pin API: customers can request a pin for a specific model ID for up to 14 days; pins expire automatically and emit metrics/events
Shadow staging: real traffic can be shadowed to candidate model with no user-facing exposure and with dashboards for key deltas (latency, token usage, top-of-response QA checks)
Telemetry thresholds: pre-configured gates (e.g., latency p95 <= 1.5x baseline, safety-failure-rate <= 0.2%) that must pass to keep pin beyond initial 72h window
Audit log entries recorded for each pin request (requester, justification, expiry, approval path)
Playbook created for emergency rollback and one-click disable for pinned model
Stakeholders (PM, Eng runtime, Evals, Security, Account Exec) have signed off on acceptance criteria
tradeoffs_and_constraints: Eval-lite reduces time-to-exposure but cannot fully replace comprehensive eval gates; risk of undiscovered failure modes remains
Temporary pins add operational complexity (storage of pin state, expiration enforcement, billing attribution), we limit initial rollout to <10 enterprise tenants
Shadowing increases compute cost; we'll require customers to cover incremental cost or accept throttling
Automated unpin or expiry is safer than manual revocation but requires robust notifications to customers and AE teams
implementation_notes: Backend: small additions to catalog service to store pin metadata and expiry; hook into routing layer to honor pin for tenant ID
Eval-lite: curated subset of eval harness with a config-driven checklist. Use existing eval infra but cap input set size to 200 examples
Observability: new dashboard panels in Console for pinned-model deltas and a pin-lifecycle view
Security & Compliance: require account-rep approval; logs pushed to customer audit stream in Private deployments
Billing: tag tokens consumed by a pinned run for invoice lines, POC billing agreement with sales required
notes_for_reviews: Requesting runtime team review on routing behavior for tenant-scoped pin precedence vs. global routing policies
Evals team to confirm representative example set for eval-lite and document false-positive/false-negative expectations
Security to validate that audit events meet enterprise compliance (timestamped, signer id, signed-by AE)
Product to coordinate AE beta program rollout and customer communication templates
